name: Georgia Long-Term Care Ombudsman Program
organization: Georgia Office of the State Long-Term Care Ombudsman
description: Ombudsmen advocate for residents of nursing homes and personal care homes (assisted living) and help resolve complaints about care. Community ombudsman programs serve each area of the state.
next_step: Call 866-552-4464 and choose option 5, or file a complaint online. Give the facility’s county and ask for the community ombudsman. For immediate danger, call 911.
constraints: The ombudsman acts with the resident’s permission and is not a licensing or enforcement agency.

name: Georgia Aging and Disability Resource Connection (ADRC)
organization: Georgia DHS Division of Aging Services

constraints: Counseling and referral; each program has its own eligibility and waitlist.

name: Georgia Legal Services Program
description: Free civil legal help for people with low income and for people age 60 and older in the 154 Georgia counties outside metro Atlanta: housing, public benefits, consumer, family and other civil matters. Not criminal defense.
next_step: Call 833-457-7529 or apply online at glsp.org. Give your county and the legal problem.
constraints: Income, case type and capacity limits apply. Legal aid is not guaranteed representation.

name: Atlanta Legal Aid Society
description: Free civil legal help for people with low income in Clayton, Cobb, DeKalb, Fulton and Gwinnett counties. Not criminal defense.
next_step: Call 404-524-5811 or use the online intake application. If you are 60 or older, call the Georgia Senior Legal Hotline.
constraints: Income, case type and capacity limits apply. Legal aid is not guaranteed representation.

name: Georgia Senior Legal Hotline
description: Free legal advice, brief service and referrals by phone for Georgians age 60 and older, on almost any civil legal problem. Run by Atlanta Legal Aid Society with the Division of Aging Services.
next_step: Age 60 or older anywhere in Georgia: call 888-257-9519 (metro Atlanta: 404-389-9992). You can also reach it through 866-552-4464, option 7. An attorney calls back.
constraints: Advice and brief service; ongoing representation depends on the local legal aid program.

name: VA medical centers serving Georgia
description: Three VA medical centers are in Georgia: Atlanta VA Health Care System, Decatur (404-321-6111); Charlie Norwood VA Medical Center, Augusta (706-733-0188); and Carl Vinson VA Medical Center, Dublin (478-272-1210). Each runs clinics across its area; some south Georgia clinics, such as Waycross, belong to VA’s Florida network.
next_step: Use VA’s facility locator with your ZIP code to find the closest clinic and its medical center. Not enrolled yet? Call 877-222-8387 or ask your GDVS field office for help applying.
constraints: VA does not publish county lists for these medical centers, so this card does not assign counties. Your VA care team may be at a different clinic or system; follow what VA tells you.

source_evidence.scope: Medical centers, main phones and the VISN 8 Waycross clinic; search excerpt.
